name: UCSD Spring 2023

venue.name: UC San Diego
venue.address: Price Center, UCSD, 9500 Gilman Dr, La Jolla, CA 92093

information:
This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [New Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UCSDSpring2023#26385-new-competitors).

It will take place in West Ballroom B (second floor) of [UC San Diego's Price Center](https://universitycenters.ucsd.edu/_images/visit-us-images/PC_Directories11X17FA21_FNL1.pdf).
